name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata pauses at the gate, shifting her weight and pressing her hand briefly against the pouch at her waist. She glances toward the road home, then gives Mariam a small, apologetic smile. "Thank you, Mariam," she says quietly. "I am tired, and I have not eaten yet. I need to go home, rest, and look at my wall photos." She gives a gentle nod and starts walking toward the road.
reason: Aminata felt a brief pull to accept Mariam's warm invitation and rest her aching back, but memories of a recent outing where she stayed too long over plantains and woke heavy the next morning, as well as an earlier tea-stall visit where she spent an unplanned coin, reminded her of her father's rule to finish work before celebrating. Hungry since midday and wanting to review her wall photos to improve her plastering, she chose to decline politely and head home to eat and study.
